clauses.signature: void read_tree(int *n, int *u, int *v)
clauses.code: scanf("%d", n); for(int i=0;i<*n-1;i++){ scanf("%d %d", &u[i], &v[i]); u[i]--; v[i]--; }

clauses.signature: void bipartition(int n, const int *u, const int *v, int *col)
int find_move(int n, const int *col, char *used, int *out_a, int *out_b)
void play_game(int n, const int *col, const char *adj)
int main(void)
clauses.code: int main(void){ int n; static int u[205],v[205]; read_tree(&n,u,v); int *col=(int*)malloc((size_t)n*sizeof(int)); static char adj_dummy=0; bipartition(n,u,v,col); play_game(n,col,&adj_dummy); free(col); return 0; }
